description: This file contains the implementation of the VisitValidator class used for validating Visit objects in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It ensures that Visit instances adhere to various constraints such as required fields, logical date relationships, non-overlapping visits for the same patient, and attribute correctness.

classes.name: VisitValidator
classes.description: A validator class for validating Visit entities, implementing Spring's Validator interface. It performs comprehensive validation checks including required fields, date consistency, overlapping visit prevention, and attribute validation.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if this validator supports validating instances of the given class, specifically supporting the Visit class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Visit object, checking for required fields, date relationships, overlapping visits, and attribute correctness, and reports errors where validation fails.

methods.name: disallowOverlappingVisits
methods.description: Private helper that returns true if overlapping visits are not allowed, based on global property.

methods.name: allowOverlappingVisits
methods.description: Private helper that returns true if overlapping visits are permitted, based on the global property setting.

methods.name: validateVisitStartedBeforePatientBirthdate
methods.description: Checks if the visit start date is before the patient's birth date (considering estimated birthdate margin), and adds an error if invalid.

methods.name: getPatientBirthdateAdjustedIfEstimated
methods.description: Returns the patient's birthdate adjusted forward if it is estimated, adding grace period based on age.

methods.name: calculateGracePeriodInYears
methods.description: Calculates the grace period in years based on patient's age and predefined margins.
